app.title: ErgScan
app.tagline: Scan your Concept2 PM4/PM5 results and export a FIT file

capture.hint: Photograph the PM4/PM5 results screen straight on, with the table filling most of the frame and no glare on the digits.

guide.title: Get the right screen
guide.open: How to get the results screen

pick.question: Which monitor do you have?
pick.hint: The menus differ a little between the two models, so the steps are made for yours.

pm5.name: Concept2 PM5
pm5.look: Black monitor with Units, Display and Menu buttons below the screen

pm4.name: Concept2 PM4
pm4.look: Grey monitor with Change Units, Change Display and Menu {'|'} Back buttons
pm4.memoryPath: More Options › Memory › List by Date › 🔍
pm4.memoryNote: The PM4 only keeps the 10 most recent workouts, so open the results before your next session.

guide.intro: ErgScan reads the results table with the total and the splits. Follow these steps on the monitor so that table is what you photograph.

setup.title: Start a workout
setup.body: Pick a set distance or set time workout so the result is split into parts. Just Row also works: start rowing from the main menu.
setup.path: Select Workout › Standard List, or New Workout › Single Distance / Single Time

finish.title: Finish it properly
finish.body: A set distance or time workout ends by itself when the countdown reaches zero, so keep rowing until then. For Just Row, stop rowing, wait 6 seconds and press {menu} once. Row at least 1 minute or 100 m, or nothing is saved.
finish.warning: Don't press {menu} mid-workout or during a rest: it ends the workout.

results.title: Open the results
results.body: From the main menu, open the workout from memory. Find it with the arrows (check the date and time), then press the magnifying glass button to see the total and every split.
results.note: If the monitor goes dark, press a button to wake it. The workout stays in memory.

photo.title: Take the photo
photo.body: Hold the phone straight in front of the screen, let the table fill the frame and avoid glare on the digits. Then tap Scan with camera.

camera.hint: Fit the PM screen inside the frame
camera.failed: The camera could not be started ({message}). Take or choose a photo instead.
camera.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or take or choose a photo instead.
camera.missing: No camera was found. Choose a photo instead.
camera.busy: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again, or choose a photo instead.
camera.stalled: The camera isn't responding. If your browser is asking for permission, allow it, then try again.

scan.failed: No results table was found. Try another photo or enter the workout manually.

review.title: Check the results
review.computedSummary: The total was not found on the screen, so it was calculated from the rows.
review.invalidCells: Fix the highlighted cells. Enter times like 8:00.0 (or 8.00.0) and other values as whole numbers.
review.discardNew: Discard this workout? It hasn't been saved to History.
review.discardChanges: Discard your changes to this workout?

history.title: History
history.empty: Scan or enter a workout and tap Save to keep it here.
history.removeConfirm: Delete the workout from {date}? This can't be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showIntroDetail: The welcome card with the photo tip
settings.clearDetail: No saved workouts. Resets the theme and intro, and shows the guide again | Deletes 1 saved workout, resets the theme and intro, and shows the guide again | Deletes {count} saved workouts, resets the theme and intro, and shows the guide again
settings.clearConfirm: Delete all saved workouts and reset settings? This can't be undone.

export.invalid: Fill in the total time and distance to save the workout.
export.saveFirst: Save the workout to share or download the FIT file.
